ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: both models score similarly on Creative Generation (78.8 vs 82.7 — note Willet is actually slightly higher), so capability isn't the deciding factor. I chose Lapwing because this is an open-ended generative task, and Willet's documented behavioral note shows a measured *aversion* to such work (a self-reported preference, not a quality effect). Routing a creative, loosely-specified task to the model that doesn't disprefer it is the cleaner match, even though either could handle it well.
